kurz: The skin protects the delicate flesh and turns crisp if the fish cooks on it for almost the whole time.
bild_im_kopf: Like an oven glove that turns crisp: the skin protects and fries at the same time.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Pat the skin dry and scrape it with the back of a knife
schluesselmomente.warum: As little water on the skin as possible: otherwise it sticks and won't crisp.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Lay it in well-heated oil and press lightly for the first few seconds
schluesselmomente.warum: The skin contracts in the heat and curls. Pressing keeps it flat on the pan.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Fry about three quarters of the time skin side down, until the flesh has turned opaque halfway up
schluesselmomente.warum: The skin insulates: the flesh cooks gently from below while the skin browns.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Turn only briefly and take it off at about 50 °C core temperature (as a guide)
schluesselmomente.warum: That way salmon stays juicy and slightly translucent in the middle.
